_about: Column definitions for the two raw extraction sheets. The sheets are the source of truth and are never modified by code; code/load_data.R reads them and applies the inclusion rules documented there. Placeholder rows (a publication listed but no numbers extracted) are allowed and are excluded by code.

breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.author: First author surname
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.study: Study identifier within the publication, as text (blank = single study; treated as '1'). A letter suffix marks independent participant blocks within one study, e.g. Levinson 2014 1a (original probe order, n = 120) vs 1b (reversed order; the n = 44 replication block plus the n = 93 questionnaire sample, which overlap). Rows sharing a study code are modelled as one sample.
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.breathtask: Breath-tracking task variant. BCT = breath counting task (Levinson et al., 2014); MBAS = mindful breathing awareness scale (Frewen); MBE = mindful breathing exercise (Burg); BAT, RTT, MCT = other variants. MVP analyses use BCT only.
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.breathtask_count: Breaths per counting cycle (9 in the standard BCT)
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.bell_interval: MBAS only: interval between probe bells
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.category: Construct family of the correlate: mindfulness | wellbeing | EF (executive function)
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.correlate: Questionnaire or task (subscale after a hyphen). See scales_corr.xlsx for full names.
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.r: Pearson correlation between BCT accuracy and the correlate, as reported
breathpubs_corr.xlsx (sheet 'experiments.reverse: 1 if a higher score on the correlate means LESS mindful / WORSE wellbeing / WORSE executive function. Code multiplies r by -1 for these rows so that positive = good.

breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.study_type: prepost = BCT measured before and after a period; intervention = BCT used as the intervention itself (no BCT outcome; excluded)
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.author: First author surname
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.intervention: Arm label: intervention name, or for controls the control type (waitlist, n-back, attention, imagery, '-' = no training, followup = later re-test of the intervention arm; excluded)
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.intervention_length: Duration in weeks unless stated otherwise
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.breathtask_feedback: Whether accuracy feedback was given during the task (UNSPEC = not reported)
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.mean1: Mean BCT accuracy (% correct cycles) at pre-test
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.sd1: SD at pre-test (blank if only SEM reported)
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.sem1: SEM at pre-test (converted to SD in code as sem * sqrt(n))
breathpubs_prepost.xlsx (sheet 'experime.warnings: Extraction concerns. 'values from digitization!' = means/SDs read off a figure with a plot digitizer (see code/digitize_*.py)

publications.csv: one row per publicatio.first_author: Matches the 'author' column of the sheets
publications.csv: one row per publicatio.year: Year as published (may differ from the sheets where a paper was online-first)
publications.csv: one row per publicatio.title: Full title
publications.csv: one row per publicatio.sheet_status: extracted = numbers taken into a sheet; placeholder = listed but no data extracted
publications.csv: one row per publicatio.notes: Discrepancies with the sheets, exclusion reasons, etc.
